answer: We define a spectral partition barrier where the transition matrix of a personalized EigenTrust flow exhibits rapid decay across the sparse cut isolating the adversary. This karst of poorly connected nodes ensures that any adversarial ripple of synthetic identities fails to penetrate the honest tundra of validators. By coupling this structural bound with zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions and slashing penalties on staking collateral, we enforce a negative expected attack utility that guarantees a robust Nash equilibrium.
